topic: University students protested the nationwide lecturers' strike: University of Nairobi students blocked Waiyaki Way in Nairobi over the strike that began 2 October, and UNSA threatened daily nationwide student demonstrations
scale: City roadblock: UoN students barricaded sections of Waiyaki Way with stones and burning tyres, halting traffic; UNSA called on students nationwide to unite and threatened daily demonstrations until the strike is resolved
quote1: The demonstrations followed a 72-hour ultimatum issued by the University of Nairobi Students Association (UNSA), which warned the government that students would take to the streets if the lecturers’ strike was not resolved.
quote2: The protest followed a 72-hour ultimatum from the University of Nairobi Students Association (UNSA). In a statement on Friday, October 16, UNSA president Ahmed Rashid said students would take to the streets if the strike was not resolved after the deadline.
